commentary.text: 90+9' Francois Letexier is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+5' Radoslaw Majecki (Monaco) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
90+5' Substitution. Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Folarin Balogun walks off.
90+4' Edan Diop (Monaco) has tested the patience of referee Francois Letexier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' Elye Wahi (Lens) has tested the patience of referee Francois Letexier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

90+1' 2 - 3 Takumi Minamino (Monaco) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Brice Samba is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 2:3.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Ayanda Sishuba (Lens) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
88' It's time for a substitution. Ayanda Sishuba (Lens) comes on in place of David Pereira da Costa.
87' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Radoslaw Majecki easily deals with the threat.
86' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but Radoslaw Majecki comes off his line to gather the ball.
86' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
85' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Lens will have a corner.
83' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
82' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty low to the middle of the goal, but it's not enough to beat Brice Samba who easily stops the effort.
82' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Brice Samba (Lens) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
81' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) is going to take the penalty!
79' Brice Samba (Lens) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul. Monaco are given a penalty!
77' 2 - 2 Goal! Wesley Said (Lens) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:2.
77' A fine pass finds Wesley Said (Lens) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Radoslaw Majecki reacts superbly to deny him.
77' Facundo Medina (Lens) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
75' Francois Letexier blows his whistle. Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) commits a foul after dangerous play.
73' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
73' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) can bury his head in the sand! He misses the rebound from inside the penalty box as he plants a header high over the bar! A typical school boy’s error!
71' Wissam Ben Yedder goes off the pitch and Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) comes on.
71' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Andy Diouf will be replaced by Neil El Aynaoui (Lens).
70' That will be all from Adrien Thomasson who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Wesley Said (Lens).
69' Francois Letexier interrupts the game. One of the players from Monaco won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
67' Florian Sotoca (Lens) latches on to a cross but heads the ball miles wide of the right post. Such a bad header.
64' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nampalys Mendy (Lens) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' Adi Hutter has decided to make a change. Edan Diop (Monaco) replaces Kassoum Ouattara.
62' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Folarin Balogun (Monaco) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
60' The Lens players can’t believe it after referee Francois Letexier signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
59' There's a break in play and referee Francois Letexier must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lens using VAR. This could be interesting!
58' Florian Sotoca (Lens) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
58' Lens take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

57' Andy Diouf (Lens) accepts a pass deep inside the box and after a nice touch sends the ball towards the right side of the goal. It is a pretty sweet shot, but one of the defenders changes the trajectory of the ball and deflects it onto the post. What an unlucky moment for Andy Diouf (Lens). He must have smashed a mirror recently.
55' David Pereira da Costa (Lens) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Radoslaw Majecki is alert and denies him.
53' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) has tested the patience of referee Francois Letexier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
53' Kevin Danso (Lens) meets a cross on the edge of the box and gets his head on the ball, but it goes a whisker wide of the left post.
51' Lens will take a corner kick.

51' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom left corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Radoslaw Majecki. Corner kick. Lens will have an opportunity.
51' 8:11 – the total goal attempt statistics.
47' A dangerous towering header by Florian Sotoca (Lens) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
46' The ball goes out of play and Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Radoslaw Majecki (Monaco) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
46' Looks like Radoslaw Majecki (Monaco) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
46' Franck Haise has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Florian Sotoca (Lens) comes on the pitch for Jonathan Gradit.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Facundo Medina (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francois Letexier had an easy-decision to make.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
42' Lens have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
41' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Lens get a corner.
37' Elye Wahi (Lens) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Radoslaw Majecki tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
37' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francois Letexier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
33' Rough tackle by Elye Wahi (Lens). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Referee Francois Letexier points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Lens players celebrate.
31' Attention! Referee Francois Letexier straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
31' 1 - 2 Elye Wahi (Lens) drives the ball low towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes inside off the post!
30' 0 - 2 GOAL after a blunder! Keeper Brice Samba makes a complete hash of a weak close range shot from Takumi Minamino (Monaco) and let’s the ball squirm into the net. It’s now 0:2.
28' The ball goes out for a corner. Lens can continue in their attacking effort.
26' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
25' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
25' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
24' Jhoanner Chavez is substituted due to injury. Franck Haise gives a chance to Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens).
24' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
20' Elye Wahi (Lens) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

19' 0 - 1 Folarin Balogun (Monaco) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Brice Samba is just a bystander as the ball flies into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
18' One of the players from Lens times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
17' Francois Letexier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Facundo Medina (Lens).
14' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
13' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
12' PENALTY APPEAL after Elye Wahi (Lens) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
10' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) gets inside the box and tries to beat Brice Samba with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
9' A nice individual effort by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
8' Facundo Medina (Lens) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
6' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

6' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Brice Samba leaps like a salmon to deny him.
5' Elye Wahi (Lens) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Radoslaw Majecki, who smothers the ball.
3' The resulting corner from Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is cleared.
2' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Brice Samba is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Monaco will take the kick-off.
Francois Letexier will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
